verses.text: An oracle concerning Nin'eveh. The book of the vision of Na'hum of El'kosh.
The LORD is a jealous God and avenging,
The LORD is slow to anger and of great might,
He rebukes the sea and makes it dry,
The mountains quake before him,
Who can stand before his indignation?
The LORD is good,
But with an overflowing flood
What do you plot against the LORD?
Like entangled thorns they are consumed,
Did one not come out from you,
Thus says the LORD,
And now I will break his yoke from off you
The LORD has given commandment about you:
Behold, on the mountains the feet of him
The shatterer has come up against you.
(For the LORD is restoring the majesty of Jacob
The shield of his mighty men is red,
The chariots rage in the streets,
The officers are summoned,
The river gates are opened,
its mistress is stripped, she is carried off,
Nin'eveh is like a pool
Plunder the silver,
Desolate! Desolation and ruin!
Where is the lions’ den,
The lion tore enough for his whelps

Behold, I am against you, says the LORD of hosts, and I will burn your chariots in smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions; I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers shall no more be heard.
Woe to the bloody city,
The crack of whip, and rumble of wheel,
Horsemen charging,
And all for the countless harlotries of the harlot,
Behold, I am against you,
I will throw filth at you
And all who look on you will shrink from you and say,
Are you better than Thebes
Ethiopia was her strength,
Yet she was carried away,
You also will be drunken,
All your fortresses are like fig trees
Behold, your troops
Draw water for the siege,
There will the fire devour you,
You increased your merchants
Your princes are like grasshoppers,
Your shepherds are asleep,
There is no assuaging your hurt,
